stem:
The diagram shows Ajay shining a torch at three sheets P, Q and R. Through P almost all the light passes and shapes look clear. Through Q only some light passes and shapes look unclear. Through R no light passes.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Q is translucent because only some light passes and shapes look unclear.
Q is transparent because some light passes through it.
Q is opaque because shapes look unclear.
P is translucent because almost all the light passes through it.

teacher.key_rationale: Partial passage of light with unclear shapes means translucent, so Q is translucent.
teacher.figure_note: Torch light through sheets P (clear), Q (unclear/partial), R (blocked).
